RECOVER.scope: The units in appliesTo declare RECOVER in this production reference. The strategy is shared; differences are star count, max HP, range and passive.
RECOVER.summary: The caster heals itself by 25 / 25 / 50 / 100 percent of its CURRENT max HP (fallback 100) through handleHeal(request, self, apBoost 1, crit); it needs no target. handleHeal checks wound FIRST: a wounded caster heals 0 but, under BLOODMOON weather with BLOOD_STONE items, requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the raw request), apBoost 1, crit) instead (the shield helpers then apply Belt, AP, crit, enrage, alive gate; Protect does not stop it). Otherwise, at hp > 0 and without Protect: AP, crit, x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH, rounded, capped at missing HP; overheal with the GRASS effect requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal). No damage, status or movement.

effects.resolution: applied: the wound check comes FIRST: a wounded caster (status.wound) gets 0 healing and, with BLOODMOON weather and BLOOD_STONE items, a requested addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the raw request), apBoost 1, crit) that the shield helpers scale (Big Eater Belt, AP, crit, enraged x0.5) and refuse at 0 hp (Protect does not stop it; see core-mechanics section J); otherwise 0 at 0 hp or with status.protect (Rune Protect alone blocks nothing); then x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH, rounded, capped at missing HP. The uncapped excess (overheal, from the rounded heal) requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal, itself, 0, false, false) if the caster has the GRASS synergy effect. Requested, applied (healReceived) and overheal are separate amounts; the strategy ignores the returned values.

SLACK_OFF.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
SLACK_OFF.scope: SLAKOTH (1 star), VIGOROTH (2 stars, passive VIGOROTH) and SLAKING (3 stars, passive SLAKING) declare ABILITY SLACK_OFF with maxPP 100 and range 1. All are NORMAL/FIELD. The two passives are separate queue records; only their interaction with this ability's sleep is noted here.
SLACK_OFF.summary: Self only, three steps in order: clearNegativeStatus(self, self), then handleHeal(maxHP x 0.3 (0.6 at 4 stars / fallback), self, apBoost 1, crit), then triggerSleep(3000, self). The cleanse zeroes COOLDOWNS only, so a wound or burn flag is still set during the heal: wound blocks HP healing (under BLOODMOON with BLOOD_STONE it requests the shield replacement instead) and burn halves an otherwise permitted heal. The sleep is an ATTEMPT: refused if already asleep, Rune Protect, skydiving, IMMUNITY_SLEEP or ccCooldown; otherwise weather, enrage and duration reductions change the stored time and a Chesto Berry reaction can follow. VIGOROTH's spawn immunity and SLAKING's wake rage are cited only as scoped hooks; those passives are not imported here.

targeting.who: the caster only
targeting.note: requiresTarget false: castable without a target in reach.

geometry.detail: No area, no movement, no board scan.

effects.scaling: none
effects.resolution: Zeroes the cooldowns of burn, silence, fatigue, poison, freeze, sleep, confusion, wound, paralysis, charm, flinch, armor reduction, locked and blind; clears the curse flag but adds 2000 ms to a running curse cooldown; possession is kept when the origin is a teammate. The boolean flags (wound, burn, ...) are cleared by the update methods on a later status update, not inside this call (updateWound sets wound = false when its cooldown runs out).

declaredRaw.formula: handleHeal(maxHP x healFactor, caster, apBoost 1, crit)

effects.scaling: REQUESTED amount: maxHP x 0.3 for stars 1 to 3 (0.6 fallback). APPLIED amount in PokemonState.handleHeal: x(1 + AP/100) (apBoost 1), x critPower if the cast crit, x1.3 with BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 while burning, x0.5 while enraged, x1.2 under ZENITH weather, then rounded and capped at missing HP (healReceived); the rest is overheal.
effects.resolution: Nothing is healed (healReceived 0, overheal 0) when the caster's wound flag is true (a Blood Stone under BLOODMOON adds a shield instead), when its hp is 0, or when it is protected. The self cleanse runs first but only zeroes woundCooldown/burnCooldown; the wound and burn flags stay true until the update methods run, so a wounded or burning caster is still treated as wounded/burning inside this call. healDone is increased by healReceived. If overheal is above 0 and the caster has the GRASS synergy effect, 0.4 x overheal is added to max HP.

effects.scaling: REQUESTED duration: fixed 3000 ms, no AP or crit scaling. APPLIED: x1.3 under NIGHT weather, x0.7 under ZENITH, halved when enraged, then applyStatusDurationReductions (Swift Swim x0.7, Hydration x0.5, Water Veil/Surge Surfer x0.3, Odd Keystone -10% each; body read in the SING candidate, not repeated here), rounded.
effects.resolution: triggerSleep is refused when the caster is already asleep, has Rune Protect, is skydiving, has IMMUNITY_SLEEP, or has ccCooldown above 0. VIGOROTH gets IMMUNITY_SLEEP in its passive spawn effect, so for VIGOROTH the sleep is normally refused. When it applies: sleep = true and sleepCooldown = rounded duration; the unit cannot move or attack while asleep; each damage instance received shortens the remaining sleep by 300 ms; at the end ccCooldown is raised to at least CC_COOLDOWN and a SLAKING caster triggers rage for 3000 ms. The cleanse zeroed sleepCooldown first, so it does not extend an existing sleep.

statusEffects.scaling: requested 3000 ms, no AP or crit scaling; stored = round(3000 x weather (NIGHT 1.3, ZENITH 0.7) x enrage 0.5 x the caster's duration reductions)
statusEffects.guards: refused when already asleep, Rune Protect, skydiving, IMMUNITY_SLEEP or ccCooldown > 0 (executed); a CHESTO_BERRY holder requests eatBerry after it starts; the cleanse zeroed sleepCooldown first but not the sleep flag, so an existing sleep stays refused
statusEffects.combatEffect: the unit cannot move or attack while asleep; VIGOROTH's spawn immunity and SLAKING's wake rage are scoped hooks only

statusEffects.scaling: none
statusEffects.guards: no Rune Protect or immunity check; boolean flags (wound, burn, ...) are NOT cleared here, only cooldowns; the curse cooldown gets +2000 ms instead of being zeroed
statusEffects.combatEffect: wound and burn flags stay set during the following heal (executed: burn halves it, wound blocks it)

starBehavior.note: The caster's stars index the heal fraction (0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.6 fallback). The sleep duration does not depend on stars. Catalog units here are 1 (SLAKOTH), 2 (VIGOROTH) and 3 (SLAKING) stars, so every catalog caster heals 30% of max HP (requested).

Requested sleep: 3000 ms; applied after weather, rage and reductions, or refused (already asleep, Rune Protect, skydiving, IMMUNITY_SLEEP, ccCooldown).

AURORA_VEIL.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare AURORA_VEIL: Alolan Vulpix (1 star) and Alolan Ninetales (2 stars); both have maxPP 80, range 2 and no declared passive. The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star count (table index).
AURORA_VEIL.summary: Needs no target. Each non-null same-team board entity, the caster included, receives addShield(5 / 10 / 20 / 50, caster, apBoost 1, crit) THEN triggerRuneProtect(1000, recipient, caster). The shield follows the usual helper order (recipient Belt, caster AP and crit, enrage, alive gate). triggerRuneProtect sets Rune Protect, clears negative cooldowns (most flags stay until updates) and keeps a longer remaining rune timer. Rune Protect is not Protect: it blocks status triggers that test it, not damage or HP healing (executed). The rune application depends on neither shield success nor the recipient being alive in this loop.

Nothing is added to an ally with hp 0.

The belt and enraged state depend on each receiving ally, not on the caster, so the applied amount can differ between allies. No timer or removal here; later damage consumes the shield.

SURGE_SURFER.nameCollision: Passive.SURGE_SURFER (this record) is NOT EffectEnum.SURGE_SURFER, the aquatic-synergy tier effect that cuts status durations (x0.3) in applyStatusDurationReductions. The two share a name only.
SURGE_SURFER.kind: stat-while-field passive (no PassiveEffects entry: logic lives in Status.add/remove*Field)
SURGE_SURFER.summary: Each time the holder gains an electric field or a psychic field (through the Status add-field methods) it gets +30 speed; losing that field removes the 30 again. Both fields: +60. Nothing else is done by the passive itself.
SURGE_SURFER.trigger: Status.addElectricField / Status.addPsychicField called on the holder while the field flag was false; Status.removeElectricField / removePsychicField while it was true

effects.scaling: addSpeed(30, self, apBoost 0, crit false): no AP or crit scaling; Big Eater Belt/Twist Band hooks still run in addSpeed; speed is clamped at 0..MAX_SPEED

conditions: The add method returns early if that field flag is already true, so each field gives +30 at most once (max +60 with both).
The holder is recognised by entity.passive === Passive.SURGE_SURFER; entity.passive is set in the PokemonEntity constructor through changePassive (no effect registered there).

Field sources that go through addElectricField / addPsychicField: ELECTRIC_TERRAIN and PSYCHIC_TERRAIN synergy effects (the unit must have that type: Alolan Raichu has both Electric and Psychic types), units flagged supercharged at simulation start, a storm-weather lightning strike on an Electric-type unit, Terrain Extender (item), Herba Mystica Spicy/Sour dishes, Terrain Pulse, Electrify, Expanding Force.

Field sources that set the flag DIRECTLY (Volt Surge, Tadbulb-supercharge passive, Pincurchin passive) bypass the add method, so they give a field flag but NOT the +30 speed (and a later remove call would then subtract 30 that was never added: unexamined).

Terrain Extender selects the first of the holder's types (in its type order) among Electric/Grass/Psychic/Fairy: for Alolan Raichu (Electric, Fairy, Psychic) that is Electric, so the item alone gives the electric field only.
SURGE_SURFER.relatedFieldEffects: Independent of this passive, an attacker with an electric field deals x1.2 damage in handleDamage and a psychic field a second x1.2 (the multipliers stack). That is a field effect, not part of SURGE_SURFER.
SURGE_SURFER.resetBehaviour: Entity status is built per fight; there is no persisted state. Within a fight the speed is removed when the field is removed (death of an ELECTRIC_TERRAIN / PSYCHIC_TERRAIN passive unit removes the field from its team). No timer or stack counter exists.

PRIMEAPE.summary: Every time the Primeape entity dies or starts a resurrection, it gains +1 ATK (permanent: also written to the board unit) and +1 stack; its STACK evolution rule needs 10 stacks, and addStack then evolves the board unit into Annihilape mid-fight.

addStack(): returns immediately when the entity has no player (e.g. a non-player opponent), otherwise increments the board unit's stacks and mirrors them to the entity

evolution.declared: Primeape: evolution ANNIHILAPE, evolutionRule STACK, stacksRequired 10 (Mankey declares evolution PRIMEAPE and no rule of its own, so it uses the inherited default rule, not examined here; Annihilape declares no evolution)
evolution.trigger: PokemonEntity.addStack calls EvolutionManager.tryEvolve ONLY when stacks === stacksRequired (exact equality) and the rule type is STACK
evolution.gate: StackEvolutionHandler.canEvolve: false when holding Eviolite or not on the player's board; otherwise stacks >= stacksRequired
evolution.result: player.transformPokemon builds the evolved unit, carries permanent stat deltas (atk delta versus a fresh Primeape is re-applied), re-adds items, then Annihilape.onAcquired subtracts 10 attack (30 - 20) 'to revert permanent atk buff stacked for evolution'
evolution.plainCaseArithmetic: Primeape atk 20 + 10 permanent points = 30 at the 10th stack; Annihilape factory 30 + carried delta 10 - onAcquired 10 = 30. This assumes exactly 10 permanent points and no other permanent atk changes; it is arithmetic on the cited lines, not an observed result. A death or resurrection of the same entity after the evolution would add +1 more permanent attack to the Annihilape board unit (see lifecycle)
evolution.checkedAgainstOldNotes: The earlier pilot-evolution note was re-checked against the source: STACK rule, stacksRequired 10, the === test, the >= handler, the Eviolite/board gates and the +1 atk/addStack pair all hold. Newly established here: death/resurrection are mutually exclusive triggers, addStack ignores entities without a player, the atk delta is carried through carryOverPermanentStats and trimmed by Annihilape.onAcquired.

lifecycle.freshAnnihilape: a newly created Annihilape (catalog instance, purchase, or the board unit produced by evolution) declares passive NONE, so a fight entity built from it has no PRIMEAPE effects and gains no stacks
lifecycle.existingEntityAfterMidFightEvolution: addStack changes only the existing entity's index, name and refToBoardPokemon (pokemon-entity.ts:1817-1822); it does not call changePassive. Read from the code: that entity keeps passive PRIMEAPE and its OnDeath/OnResurrecting effects for the rest of the fight, so a further death or resurrection would call addPrimeapeStack again: +1 ATK written permanently to the (now Annihilape) board unit and +1 on its stacks. The evolution rule re-check reads refToBoardPokemon.evolutionRule (Annihilape: not STACK), so no further evolution is attempted from addStack
lifecycle.status: traced by reading only: other code that might rebuild the entity's passive or effects after the evolution (client sync, simulation hooks, end-of-fight handling) was not searched exhaustively; the changePassive callers found in app/ do not include this path. The permanent-ATK arithmetic below holds only if no further stack lands after the 10th

conditions: Eviolite: StackEvolutionHandler.canEvolve returns false while it is held, and PokemonEntity.addStack calls tryEvolve only when stacks === stacksRequired, so on the addStack path an Eviolite holder that reaches 10 stacks does not evolve and stacks 11, 12, ... do not call tryEvolve again. This conclusion is limited to the inspected addStack path: other tryEvolve callers were not exhaustively listed, and canEvolve itself uses >=, so a different path that calls tryEvolve later could evolve it.
canEvolve also requires the unit to be on the player's board (stack-evolution-handler.ts:9).
A resurrection and the death that follows it each give a stack when they occur (two events), but a single hit that resurrects gives one (the death effect does not proc then).
PRIMEAPE.resetBehaviour: The stack count lives on the board Pokemon (refToBoardPokemon.stacks) and the permanent attack on its atk, so both persist across fights in the code read. DRUMMER.kind: marker passive with no PassiveEffects entry; behaviour is a branch in MovingState.update that calls drumBeat
DRUMMER.summary: Passive.DRUMMER has no PassiveEffects entry. It is read in MovingState.update: when the unit has a full-PP no-target cast, that cast comes first; otherwise, if a target is at range it attacks as usual; otherwise, if the board holds any unit of its own team whose passive is neither DRUMMER nor INANIMATE, it calls drumBeat(pokemon, board) instead of walking toward a target. drumBeat sets the attack cooldown to a 1000 base at the unit's speed (halved speed while paralysed); if pp >= maxPP and it can cast, it casts its skill at the nearest target at sight and stops; otherwise it adds 1 to attackCount, sets targetY to -1, and gives every adjacent (8-neighbour) same-team unit that is not a DRUMMER requested PP of 2 / 3 / 5 for 1 / 2 / 3 stars (GROOKEY / THWACKEY / RILLABOOM), then runs its OnAttack effects with no target and zero damage. The PP amount is requested only: it goes through addPP with the drummer as caster, AP boost 0 and no crit, so the applied change is halved (rounded) by fatigue and is not applied at all (a positive gain) if the receiver is silenced, has status.protect (Protect), has NO_PP_GAIN or is resurrecting (a receiver with only Rune Protect is not blocked: addPP tests status.protect, not status.runeProtect; +5 on PP 10 gives 10 with Protect, 15 with Rune Protect alone, 13 with fatigue); the result is clamped to 0..2 x maxPP - 1. The adjacent receiver filter excludes DRUMMER but does not exclude INANIMATE units, while the trigger filter does.

WATER_SPRING.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
WATER_SPRING.kind: no PassiveEffects entry; beforeSimulationStart on the unit classes adds EffectEnum.WATER_SPRING to the opponent team's effect set, which gives opposing units a shared OnAbilityCastEffect
WATER_SPRING.summary: Passive.WATER_SPRING has no PassiveEffects entry. Instead each of MUDKIP, MARSHTOMP and SWAMPERT overrides beforeSimulationStart to add EffectEnum.WATER_SPRING to the opponent's effect set (the hook is called for every unit on a player's board, bench included, before entities are built). When the opponent's entities are added, applySynergyEffects runs every effect in the team set through applyEffect; the WATER_SPRING case adds the shared WaterSpringEffect (an OnAbilityCastEffect with origin Passive.WATER_SPRING) to every opposing unit's effectsSet. Afterwards, whenever one of those opposing units finishes castAbility (and was able to cast), the effect scans the board and for every unit with passive WATER_SPRING that is on a different team than the caster calls addPP(5, itself, 0, false) and broadcasts that unit's skill animation. The amount is the same for all three evolutions (stars do not scale it). The +5 is a requested amount: addPP rounds it, halves it under fatigue, and does not apply it at all when the receiver is silenced, has status.protect (Protect), has NO_PP_GAIN or is resurrecting (a receiver with only Rune Protect still gains the PP: addPP tests status.protect, not status.runeProtect; +5 on PP 10 gives 10 with Protect, 15 with Rune Protect alone, 13 with fatigue); the result is clamped to 0..2 x maxPP - 1 (maxPP 60 here, so up to 119). Twist Band only changes negative values and Big Eater Belt is not used by addPP, so neither alters +5. Each cast of any opposing unit grants +5 to each Water Spring unit; two holders each gain separately, and the effect is added to the enemy team once per entity even if several Water Spring units exist.
